summary: Refined architectural governance and telemetry by integrating advanced numerical methods, including Bayesian inference, manifold learning, and robust statistical validation. The implementation of a 'stats_engine.py' module, featuring Gaussian Latency Monitors and Beta-Binomial conjugate priors, shifted focus from task-based metrics to outcome-oriented, uncertainty-aware architectural reliability.
key_learnings: AST-based parsing and Pydantic validation ensure system determinism.
Bayesian inference and conjugate priors enable efficient, real-time uncertainty modeling without MCMC overhead.
Statistical rigor requires evaluating effect sizes, bootstrap confidence intervals, and distribution checks to mitigate noise and p-hacking.
UMAP and t-SNE, with PCA preprocessing, effectively visualize semantic stagnation and thematic drift.
Architectural documentation is most valuable when it captures the rationale behind implementation choices and long-term reliability outcomes.
